selection_basis: Different Defects4J projects; no hits for these IDs in the inspected 97-bug archive or existing configs/docs/reports. Check external experiment registers before asserting previously unused.
split_role: exploratory feasibility, never held-out claims after tuning
required_before_execution: Official buggy revision pinned to full Git SHA
Observed failing-test log with checksum and test command/Java version
One identical gold-free candidate-generation procedure for all arms
Installed provider model with immutable digest and supported context
Local exact-text dense/sparse bundles for topo conditions
initial_model: qwen2.5:7b to match archived generation where practical; record digest, quantization and actual server hardware
additional_models: Separate runs per installed open-weight model; Qwen/DeepSeek/Llama parameter counts and context limits remain explicit, not inferred from names
input_counter: UTF-8 message bytes + 256 proxy unless an explicit local chat-template tokenizer is supplied
context_note: Do not silently change context mid-comparison; larger context needs a separate condition and reservation analysis
reference_only: Optional Full at 120000 tokens, clearly separate from equal-budget arms
ordered_ablations: BM25 relevance only, repair off, paths off
Same target schedule and allowance with real dense/sparse selector and propagation off
Paths then repair, report infeasible cases
Adaptive routing only after fixed schedules
cost_interpretation: Hard bounded cap, not an expected bill. Preflight before launch. Stop if unknown usage. Embedding time and memory recorded separately; no automatic downloads.
metrics: Candidate recall, strict Java and historical profiles
Logical input+output tokens including paid invalid requests
Physical provider counters and unresolved reservations
subsequent_exploratory_set: Preselect 10-15 independent bugs across at least 4 projects before results; exclude all prior development/smoke bugs and freeze split hashes
held_out_stage: A larger untouched set after development choices freeze; estimate defect-level uncertainty only with independent bugs
lightgbm_gate: Only after multiple independent bugs, grouped splits, full-cost/action labels and calibration data exist; never train/calibrate on synthetic fixtures and call it learned real risk
